crossRefs.note: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all…
For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us…
But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God…
I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be…
Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being…
Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies…
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
He said to his brothers, “My money is restored! Behold, it is in my sack!” Their hearts failed them, and they turned…
men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens…

translations.web: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
translations.bsb: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.
translations.kjv: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth
translations.asv: For innumerable evils have compassed me about; Mine iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; They are more than the hairs of my head; And my heart hath failed me.
